title: Chapter 22: Harvest Of Victory
content:
Chapter 22: Harvest Of Victory

According to Wu Qing's understanding, the energy cultivated in the body of a creature with one-star strength is extremely limited, and it is not good for increasing strength and sustaining bursts.

The combat power of the upgraded puppy can be regarded as superior among creatures that are not in the star.

The strength level of this one-star bear goblin knight is not comparable, so it cannot be seen, but the secret technique of the bear goblin priest can at least make his strength reach the average level.

Under such conditions, it is very suitable for testing.

At this time, there were no less than 20 puppies surrounding the one-star bear goblin knight. At Wu Qing's command, they pounced on him.

This time, the puppies did not hold back at all, and they all fought hard with a life-for-life fighting style.

"God of the Spirit!"

The one-star bear goblin knight shouted the name of God, and the energy in his body burst out, driving the lizard mount to run.

He danced the mace in his hand for a few circles, and the first few puppies who rushed up were knocked away.

But more puppies attacked him from all directions. The powerful burst could not be used continuously and the duration was very short. After he knocked out several puppies, he seemed a little weak.

Let the other puppies successfully attack the lizard mount and launched a fierce attack on it.

With sharp claws and fangs, the lizard mount, which was not as strong as the star, lost the strong protection of the knight and was severely injured in an instant, losing the ability to move.

Seeing this, the bear goblin knight decisively jumped off the mount, leaned against the mount's body, and continued to swing the mace to open the attacking puppies.

Without the charge of the mount, his own energy was exhausted by the previous bursts. He now only relied on his own strength to swing the mace, and the power was greatly reduced.

The attacked puppies, slow down, can continue to attack.

More and more puppies besieged, taking turns to fight, not giving the bear goblin knight a chance to recover. The lizard mount behind him has died, and the body turned into light and disappeared.

"Roar!"

The one-star knight, who lost the protection of the lizard mount and was surrounded on all sides, roared and fell unwillingly under the claws of the puppy.

Wu Qing calculated that this one-star bear goblin knight, who was blessed by the sacrifice, had a total of three bursts of combat power, and several puppies were killed or injured each time.

In the end, the one-star bear goblin knight and his lizard mount were exhausted, and a total of 7 puppies died, nearly 20 were seriously injured, and minor injuries were not counted.

This is because the puppy's vitality is extremely tenacious and can automatically recover from injuries.

Ordinary native creatures, facing such powerful enemies, are expected to suffer heavy casualties, and it is very likely that he will escape successfully.

Wu Qing asked the Queen of Insects to record these numbers. The Queen of Insects is now more and more like a competent biological super brain.

A one-star creature provides a lot of resources, and more importantly, by absorbing his luck, the star upgrade requirement of the mother nest has become 1/10.

…

On the other side, the puppies that rushed past the one-star bear goblin knights caught up with the bear goblin priest's team again after a period of pursuit.

Five bear goblin knights took the initiative to get off their mounts, and with the priest's blessing, they instantly went berserk and attacked the puppies that caught up with them.

I don't know what secret technique the bear goblin priest used, but the five berserk bear goblin knights did not lose their minds and stayed by the priest's side very soberly.

More and more puppies caught up, and the hosts in the air also rushed over.

"It seems that there is no escape today. Before returning to the embrace of the spirit god, I will give you a great gift."

The bear goblin priest muttered as he looked at the increasing number of puppies and the latest hosts.

He knelt on the back of his mount and prayed devoutly to the spirit god.

Suddenly, the bear goblin knights and their mounts, including the giant lizard mount on the priest, who were fighting, all screamed silently to the sky, and their spirits were sucked away by an invisible force.

The figure of the bear goblin priest was getting thinner and thinner.

"Another sacrifice! So annoying!"

Wu Qing immediately ordered the dog to retreat.

But the invisible attack came very quickly, and a powerful and strange mental storm appeared out of thin air, sweeping all the creatures around!

The puppies were knocked down by this mental storm, and the host was also blown back for a distance.

Fortunately, the Zerg units have strong immunity to mental attacks, and no puppy was really hurt.

The bear goblin priest's deliberate attack was in vain.

The bear goblin priest had lost his life at this moment, and he did not see this result. The mysterious thing in his hand that provided faith energy turned into ashes and dispersed.

The cause and effect relationship was established, and all enemies turned into light and disappeared.

The bear goblin priest provided a lot of resources to the system, and the star upgrade requirement of the mother nest became 2/10.

A one-star strongman who brought Wu Qing amazement was just turned into ashes.

This place is far away from the Zerg territory. Several hosts flew over and used their tentacles to clean the battlefield and collect the items left behind.

The items on the bear goblin priest and his guardian knight must be taken back.

There are also items left by the bear goblins on two battlefields. Workers must be sent to clean them up. Now Wu Qing is the lord of Daxia Territory and has more than 2,000 people under his command. These things can be used.

In the second preset battlefield, the bear goblin warriors whose frenzy state has been lifted either died directly or were killed by hydralisks.

The bear goblin knights and soldiers who were responsible for the rear were also annihilated under the siege of puppies and hydralisks.

The last bear goblin soldier died and turned into light.

A tough battle finally came to an end.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

Wu Qing's mind withdrew from the battlefield and stopped the continuous surge of troops.

After taking stock of the combat arms, there was no loss of 200 hydralisks, and the number of lost puppies was close to 3,000, and the number has now recovered to about 600.

A puppy consumes 25 energy points, which shows the scale of resource harvest and consumption in this battle.

Wu Qing plans to increase the number of hydralisks to 300 and the number of puppies to 1,000.

This battle consumed a lot of energy resources, but basically no gas resources. The bear goblin priest has been consuming faith energy, allowing the system to obtain a lot of extra gas resources.

These gas are enough for Wu Qing to squander.

After a battle, it was already afternoon. Wu Qing continued to spread the puppies, explore the surrounding situation, and ordered them to rush back to the territory before dark.

In the Zerg territory, in order to deal with the next possible crisis, Wu Qing plans to build 30 nests in the valley to cover the entire valley space.

From now on, this valley will be the core territory of the Zerg. If it is not necessary, the Zerg buildings will not be expanded outward for the time being.

Zerg troops can appear in the world, but he is not going to let the people of this world know about these magical Zerg buildings in detail for the time being, otherwise it may cause unexpected troubles.

All dealings with the creatures of this world will be done in the name of Daxia Territory. Daxia Territory is a territory recognized by the rules of this world, and there is nothing to be picky about.

The Zerg territory in the dark is hidden in the territory of Daxia Territory. Just upgrade and develop, and keep brute-forcing.

One bright and one dark territory will definitely become a unique landscape in this world.

After the war, considering the people's hearts of the residents of Daxia Territory, Wu Qing sent 200 puppies and 50 hydralisks back to the city.

Seeing the Zerg return again, the residents of the territory were completely relieved.

These ordinary residents are not really deaf to the outside world. They are all aware of the tense situation outside.

It's just that they don't have the ability to control their own destiny.
